value: You don't see many strangers around here these days.
Safe travels out there. Watch the treeline after dark.
I have nothing more to say.
Hmph. A face I don't know.
Most folk keep to the village — wiser, maybe. The mud out here keeps its own counsel.
No one worth a name anymore. I came to the marsh to be forgotten, and it obliged.
Old things. Sunken things. Tread careful where the water goes still.
Come with me. There's nothing left for you out here.
Hah. Been a long while since anyone asked. ...Aye. Better than rotting in the mud alone. Lead on, then — I'll make my way to your fire.
Well met, traveler. I've been resting my feet by this fire.
I know these roads — the peaks, the wood, the dunes, the mire. Been walking them alone too long, if I'm honest.
Walk them with me, then. Join my party.
Ha — I thought you'd never ask. Aye, I'm with you. I'll wait at your fire till you're ready to move.
And to you. I'll be here a while yet.
